column1: # upstream-pins.tsv - the browser engine's out-of-repo third-party dependencies.
# THE SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for what the browser links, where it came from,
# and what bytes are acceptable. Read by:
#   userland/apps/browser/port/fetch-upstream.sh   (fetch + verify + extract)
#   userland/apps/browser/port/deps-publish.sh     (rebuild the bundles from upstream)
#   build/browser-deps-gate.sh                     (the table is well-formed and self-consistent)
# WHY A HASH AND NOT A VERSION OR A BRANCH. Before this file existed the browser
# built only because ONE machine happened to hold 59 MB that nothing tracked
# (the build container:<workspace>{duktape,netsurf-port}). Replacing that with a fetch is
# only an improvement if the fetch cannot silently return something different:
# a mutable URL would be WORSE than the old state, because the old state failed
# loudly. So every row carries the sha256 of the exact bundle, it is verified
# after download and BEFORE extraction, and a mismatch is fatal, never a warning.
# COLUMNS (TAB separated, in this order):
#   1 name          directory the extracted source becomes (netsurf libs), or 'duktape'
#   2 tree          netsurf-port | duktape   - which of the two trees it belongs to
#   3 kind          git     - bundle is 'git archive <pin>' of the upstream repo
#                   tarball - bundle is the upstream release tarball, byte-identical
#   4 upstream_url  where it came from originally (NOT where we fetch it from now)
#   5 pin           git commit (kind=git) or upstream version (kind=tarball)
#   6 bundle        filename under the deps base URL. Carries the pin, so moving
#                   the pin cannot reuse a URL that a cache may still hold.
#   7 sha256        sha256 of that bundle file. Maintained by deps-publish.sh.
#   8 licence       SPDX-ish identifier, and see licence-notes below
# LICENCE POSITION, in short. Every row below is MIT. The five NetSurf CORE
# LIBRARIES are MIT (each carries its own COPYING, reproduced in its bundle);
# this is NOT the GPLv2 NetSurf browser application, which MayteraOS does not
# use any part of. Duktape is MIT and its bundle is the unmodified upstream
# distribution, so LICENSE.txt and AUTHORS.rst travel with it. We redistribute
# COMPLETE AND UNMODIFIED UPSTREAM SOURCE, so there is no source-offer gap to
# fill: the bundle IS the source. MayteraOS changes to these trees are never
# made in the bundles; they are committed patches in patches/ applied on top.
#name
libwapcaplet
libparserutils
libhubbub
libcss
libdom
duktape
